name: 04-28-w5-pkg-04-regression-carry-forward-discipline
title: W5-PKG-04 regression carry-forward discipline
description: Planning-only child task for freezing how each milestone carries forward prior must-pass scenarios, retained UI smoke, screenshot artifacts, and fixed bug chains so later packages cannot claim green on stale evidence.
creator: codex
non_goals: no replacement of 04-23 authority without explicit successor adoption

structural: carry-forward table format exists for package id, touched surfaces, must-pass scenarios, must-stay-green scenarios, bug ids, screenshot manifests, and same-batch source status
behavioral: touched surfaces cannot inherit green status after a newer upstream FAIL
frontend retained smoke and screenshot artifacts must be explicitly referenced instead of assumed from prior packages
smoke: no retained smoke may advance status without same-batch source PASS and archived screenshot/video/log artifacts
known_bug: a bug remains green only when its regression file, linked scenario, and linked UI smoke all remain green

stop_conditions: any package claims progress from stale retained evidence after newer source FAIL
bug chains are considered green without linked smoke staying green
frontend screenshot artifacts are treated as optional for retained-surface acceptance
notes: This governance package is the acceptance gatekeeper for later W4 work. It does not authorize new smoke runs; it defines how current and prior smoke/screenshot evidence must be carried forward and judged. 2026-05-09 update: standalone operation-log and tenant AI action-log product pages are retired. Do not recreate frontend/apps/web-antd/__tests__/e2e/operation-log.spec.ts or ai-action-logs.spec.ts to satisfy this ledger; use the backend retirement contract and RBAC migration tests listed in relatedFiles.
